title: System-theme toggle and actual dark accessibility
preconditions: Fresh browser context defaults to system light.

steps.title: Toggle system theme to dark and scan profile
steps.expected: HTML dark class, dark card background and no WCAG violations
steps.observed: Actual dark profile; background rgb(13, 21, 38); no WCAG A/AA violations

steps.title: Toggle back to light
steps.expected: HTML light class and white card restored
